paragraphs.zh: 将34.5g  2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯(99.0％、0.1mol)，13.94g碳酸钾(99％、0.1mol)，0.226g三乙烯二胺(99％、0.001mol)，200ml丙酮，10.1g  2,2,2-三氟乙醇(99％、0.1mol)加入500ml反应瓶中，在0～5℃进行反应，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完毕后过滤，滤液浓缩。往剩余物里4.04g氢氧化钠(99％、0.1mol)，200ml水，在70～75℃进行碱解，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完全后滴加盐酸酸化，过滤，洗涤，烘干得31.58g白色粉末，纯度99.3％，收率90.5％。
paragraphs.en: 34.5 g of methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate (99.0%, 0.1 mol), 13.94 g of potassium carbonate (99%, 0.1 mol), 0.226 g of triethylenediamine (99%, 0.001 mol), 200 ml of acetone and 10.1 g of 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol (99%, 0.1 mol) were charged into a 500 ml reaction flask and reacted at 0 to 5 °C, monitored by LC until the reaction was complete; after the reaction was finished the mixture was filtered and the filtrate was concentrated. Into the residue [were put] 4.04 g of sodium hydroxide (99%, 0.1 mol) and 200 ml of water, and alkaline hydrolysis was carried out at 70 to 75 °C, monitored by LC until the reaction was complete; after the reaction was complete hydrochloric acid was added dropwise to acidify, then filtration, washing and drying gave 31.58 g of a white powder, purity 99.3%, yield 90.5%.

REAGENTS: 三乙烯二胺 is triethylenediamine, i.e. DABCO / 1,4-diazabicyclo[2.2.2]octane, charged at 0.001 mol (1 mol%), so it functions as a catalyst, but the paragraph does not label it as one. 碳酸钾 (K2CO3) at 0.1 mol is the base. The paragraph never names its own product: it says only 白色粉末 ('white powder'). The identity of that powder comes from the drawing at [0064] and from the name used for the starting material in [0068]. paragraphs.zh: 将34 .75g  2-氯-3-(2 ,2 ,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸(99 .7％、0.1mol)，0.074g  DMF(99％、0.001mol)，12g氯化亚砜(99％、0.1mol)，100ml二氯乙烷加入250ml反应瓶中，升温回流反应，反应完毕后脱尽溶剂。将11 .3g  1 ,3-环己二酮(99％、0.1mol)、100ml二氯乙烷加入反应瓶，在0～5℃滴加20.4g三乙胺(99％、0.2mol)，LC跟踪至反应完全。反应完全后，加入0.09g丙酮氰醇(95％、0.001mol)，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完全后加入水进行水洗，分层，油层脱尽溶剂，加甲醇进行重结晶，过滤，烘干得37.94g米黄色结晶粉末，纯度98.7％，收率85％。
paragraphs.en: 34.75 g of 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid (99.7%, 0.1 mol), 0.074 g of DMF (99%, 0.001 mol), 12 g of thionyl chloride (99%, 0.1 mol) and 100 ml of dichloroethane were charged into a 250 ml reaction flask; the temperature was raised and the mixture was reacted at reflux, and after the reaction was finished the solvent was stripped off completely. 11.3 g of 1,3-cyclohexanedione (99%, 0.1 mol) and 100 ml of dichloroethane were charged into the reaction flask, and 20.4 g of triethylamine (99%, 0.2 mol) was added dropwise at 0 to 5 °C, monitored by LC until the reaction was complete. After the reaction was complete, 0.09 g of acetone cyanohydrin (95%, 0.001 mol) was added, monitored by LC until the reaction was complete; after the reaction was complete water was added for a water wash, the layers were separated, the solvent was stripped completely from the oil layer, methanol was added for recrystallisation, and filtration and drying gave 37.94 g of a rice-yellow (beige) crystalline powder, purity 98.7%, yield 85%.
paragraphs.notes: READ THIS BEFORE PARSING ANY NUMBER FROM THIS PARAGRAPH. The embedded text layer inserts spurious spaces inside four numeric tokens in this paragraph, and the zh field reproduces them verbatim as instructed. The rendered page proves they are extraction artifacts of the CNIPA wide letter-spacing, not printed characters. Text layer '34 .75g' is printed 34.75g. Text layer '(2 ,2 ,2-三氟乙氧基)' is printed (2,2,2-三氟乙氧基). Text layer '(99 .7％' is printed (99.7％). Text layer '11 .3g' then '1 ,3-环己二酮' is printed 11.3g 1,3-环己二酮. Any downstream pass that tokenises on whitespace will read 34 g, 99 % and 11 g and will be wrong. THE CORRECT NUMBERS, read off the image: 34.75g / 99.7％ / 0.1mol / 0.074g DMF / 99％ / 0.001mol / 12g / 99％ / 0.1mol / 100ml / 250ml / 11.3g / 99％ / 0.1mol / 100ml / 0～5℃ / 20.4g / 99％ / 0.2mol / 0.09g / 95％ / 0.001mol / 37.94g / 98.7％ / 85％. Note that the paragraph directly above, [0065], has no such spaces, so the artifact is confined to this paragraph. SOLVENT: 二氯乙烷 is printed with no locant in both places - 'dichloroethane', never '1,2-二氯乙烷'. The 1,2-isomer has NOT been inferred into the transcription or the translation. REAGENTS: 氯化亚砜 = thionyl chloride, with DMF at 1 mol% as the acyl-chloride catalyst (the paragraph lists it as a charged component and does not call it a catalyst). 丙酮氰醇 = acetone cyanohydrin, added at 1 mol% after the O-acylation, which is the cyanide source for the Fries-type enol-ester rearrangement to the C-acyl triketone; the paragraph does not describe it as such. 米黄色 rendered literally as rice-yellow, i.e. beige. drawings.notes: Single structure, no arrow, no reagents drawn. The four substituted positions are consecutive around the ring and were read off the drawing by walking the hexagon, not inferred: the acid carbon is on the upper-left vertex, Cl on the vertex clockwise from it, the trifluoroethoxymethyl side chain on the next vertex clockwise, and the methylsulfonyl on the next after that; the two remaining vertices carry no label. Every atom label is printed at high contrast and every bond terminus is unambiguous, hence high confidence on the SMILES. structures.name: 2-{2-chloro-4-(methylsulfonyl)-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]benzoyl}cyclohexane-1,3-dione (tembotrione, 环磺酮)

drawings.notes: Single structure, no arrow, no reagents drawn. TAUTOMER AS DRAWN: the triketone (diketo) form. Both ring carbonyls are drawn as C=O, the C2 vertex carries no hydroxyl and no drawn H, and there is no enol double bond anywhere in the cyclohexane ring. The enol tautomer that this class of herbicide normally adopts is NOT what is on the page, and the SMILES records the diketo form as drawn. No stereochemistry is indicated (no wedge, no hash) at C2 or anywhere else. The benzene ring substitution was walked off the drawing vertex by vertex in the same way as drawings[0] and is identical to it apart from the C1 group. ATTRIBUTION: invention's own route - this is the final target of Example 3, drawn under the step heading [0066] '3、环磺酮的合成'. Not prior art.

structures.name: methyl 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methylsulfonyl)benzoate

drawings.notes: Single structure, no arrow, no reagents drawn. The bromomethyl group is drawn as a bond from the ring to an unlabelled vertex and a second bond from that vertex up to the label Br, so it is CH2Br and not a bromine attached directly to the ring - the intervening vertex is clearly present at magnification. The ester end is drawn H3CO-C(=O)-, i.e. the methyl ester, matching 苯甲酸甲酯 in the heading at [0071]. ATTRIBUTION: invention's own route - the product of step 1 of Example 4. Not prior art.
